component.name: Clipboard History
component.summary: High-performance Universal Clipboard History utility for Linux

description.p: Clipboard History is a modern, high-performance, and privacy-conscious clipboard manager for Linux desktop environments, serving as a drop-in replacement and upgrade to Windows Win+V.

ul.li: Wayland and X11 native clipboard tracking
Rich text, plain text, images (with low-res thumbnails), and file lists
SQLite WAL embedded database with SHA-256 content-addressable blob deduplication
Instant fuzzy search and category filtering
Password manager detection and configurable secret filters
Adaptive paste injection cascade (XTest, xdotool, wtype, ydotool)
Pinning, configurable retention TTL, and idle memory usage under 10 MB

description.p: Introduces URL De-Tracker & Privacy Cleaner (auto or on-demand telemetry query stripping) and Per-Application Blacklist & Whitelist Manager.
Introduces Multi-Item Batch Operations with Concatenate Paste (custom delimiters, lists) and a built-in Clipboard Diff Viewer with side-by-side/unified syntax-highlighted comparisons.

Introduces Sequential Paste Queue (FIFO), Permanent Snippets with dynamic template expansion, On-Demand Image OCR, Color Format Converter, Advanced Search Syntax, and Zero-Trust P2P LAN Encrypted Sync.
Added quick text transforms, offline QR code generation, AES-256-GCM storage encryption, D-Bus StatusNotifierItem tray icon, active window focus detection, and adjustable security settings.
Initial public release of Linux Universal Clipboard History utility.
